<!--
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  청명 견적서 위젯 — 한 파일 버전                             │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  아임웹 관리자 → 페이지 편집 → 위젯 추가 → 「HTML」(코드 삽입) 블록에
  이 파일 내용을 처음부터 끝까지 통째로 붙여넣으세요. PC·모바일 겸용입니다.

  고칠 곳은 바로 아래 <section ...> 한 줄뿐입니다.
    · data-pin="8282"          접속 번호 (비우면 번호 없이 열립니다)
    · data-form-url=""         웹 폼 주소를 넣으면 "웹 폼 열기" 링크가 보입니다
    · data-roof-*  data-wall-* 평당 단가와 1식 금액 (원, 숫자만)

  이 파일은 widget.html · widget.css · widget.js 를 합쳐 만든 것입니다.
  세 파일을 고친 뒤 `python3 onefile.py` 를 다시 실행하면 새로 만들어집니다.
-->

<style>
.iw-quote {
  --sheet-w: 190mm;
  --line: #000000;
  --thin: #808080;
  --head-fill: #dde9f7;
  --final-fill: #ffffcc;
  --accent: #2f6df6;
  --muted: #6b7280;
  --edge: #e3e6ea;
  --serif: "HY견명조", "Apple Myungjo", "AppleMyungjo", "NanumMyeongjo",
           "Batang", "바탕", "Times New Roman", serif;
  background: transparent;
  color: #1a1d21;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo",
               "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}

.iw-quote[data-state="open"] .iw-gate { display: none; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 게이트 */

.iw-quote .iw-gate {
  max-width: 420px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 28px 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--edge);
  border-radius: 14px;
  text-align: center;
}
.iw-quote .iw-gate__title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; }
.iw-quote .iw-gate__desc { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
.iw-quote .iw-gate__row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.iw-quote .iw-gate__error { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: #d33b3b; }

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- 입력 */

.iw-quote .iw-form {
  max-width: var(--sheet-w);
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  padding: 18px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--edge);
  border-radius: 14px;
}
.iw-quote .iw-field { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.iw-quote .iw-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
.iw-quote .iw-row .iw-field { flex: 1 1 180px; min-width: 0; }
.iw-quote .iw-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.iw-quote .iw-input,
.iw-quote .iw-btn,
.iw-quote .iw-tab { box-sizing: border-box; }
.iw-quote .iw-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 11px 12px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #1a1d21;
  background: #f7f8fa;
  border: 1px solid var(--edge);
  border-radius: 10px;
  appearance: none;
}
.iw-quote .iw-btn {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: var(--accent);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.iw-quote .iw-hint { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.iw-quote .iw-check {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.iw-quote .iw-check input { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: none; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.iw-quote .iw-guide { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); }
.iw-quote .iw-guide--mo { display: none; }
.iw-quote .iw-warn {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #a33;
  background: rgba(211, 59, 59, 0.08);
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.iw-quote .iw-link {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* ------------------------------------------ 보기 전환 · 요약 카드 (모바일용) */

.iw-quote .iw-viewtabs { display: none; }
.iw-quote .iw-cards { display: none; }
.iw-quote .iw-swipe { display: none; }

.iw-quote .iw-tab {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  padding: 11px 8px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--muted);
  background: #f2f4f7;
  border: 1px solid var(--edge);
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.iw-quote .iw-tab[aria-pressed="true"] {
  color: #ffffff;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.iw-quote .iw-card {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding: 14px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid var(--edge);
  border-radius: 12px;
}
.iw-quote .iw-card__label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.iw-quote .iw-card--sum { background: var(--final-fill); border-color: #e8e0a0; }
.iw-quote .iw-card__won { display: block; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }
.iw-quote .iw-card__hangul {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #4b5057;
  word-break: keep-all;
}
.iw-quote .iw-kv {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 5px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f2f4;
}
.iw-quote .iw-kv span { flex: 0 0 66px; color: var(--muted); }
.iw-quote .iw-kv b { flex: 1 1 auto; font-weight: 600; word-break: break-all; }

.iw-quote .iw-list {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid var(--edge);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.iw-quote .iw-listitem {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  gap: 2px 10px;
  padding: 10px 13px;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f2f4;
}
.iw-quote .iw-listitem__name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; word-break: keep-all; }
.iw-quote .iw-listitem__calc { grid-row: 2; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.iw-quote .iw-listitem__amount {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  align-self: center;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.iw-quote .iw-listitem--total { background: #f7f8fa; }
.iw-quote .iw-listitem--final { background: var(--final-fill); }
.iw-quote .iw-cardnote { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; word-break: keep-all; }
.iw-quote .iw-cardnote span { display: block; }
.iw-quote .iw-swipe { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- 견적서 본체 */

.iw-quote .iw-sheetwrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.iw-quote .iw-sheet {
  width: var(--sheet-w);
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 4mm 0 6mm;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  color: #000000;
}
.iw-quote .iw-sheet__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 6px;
  text-align: center;
}
.iw-quote .iw-sheet__rule {
  width: 44%;
  height: 2px;
  margin: 4px auto 10px;
  background: #a5a5a5;
}
.iw-quote .iw-sheet table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  table-layout: fixed;
}
.iw-quote .iw-top { border: 2px solid var(--line); }
.iw-quote .iw-main { border: 2px solid var(--line); border-top: 0; }
.iw-quote .iw-note { margin-top: 6px; border: 2px solid var(--line); }
.iw-quote .iw-foot { margin-top: 5px; border: 2px solid var(--line); }

.iw-quote .iw-th,
.iw-quote .iw-td {
  padding: 3px 5px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 400;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
  border: 1px solid var(--thin);
  word-break: keep-all;
}
.iw-quote .iw-th { background: var(--head-fill); letter-spacing: 1px; }
.iw-quote .iw-td { background: #ffffff; }
.iw-quote .iw-td--num { text-align: right; font-size: 10px; padding-right: 8px; }
.iw-quote .iw-td--addr { font-size: 10px; }

.iw-quote .iw-top .iw-greet {
  width: 39.5%;
  padding: 10px 6px;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: #ffffff;
}
.iw-quote .iw-greet__line {
  display: block;
  padding: 6px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.iw-quote .iw-vlabel {
  width: 5.2%;
  padding: 6px 0;
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--head-fill);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.iw-quote .iw-vlabel span { display: block; padding: 5px 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.iw-quote .iw-td--seal { position: relative; padding-right: 34px; }
.iw-quote .iw-seal {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 2px;
  width: 34px;
  height: auto;
  margin-top: -17px;
}

.iw-quote .iw-col1 { width: 22.2%; }
.iw-quote .iw-col2 { width: 22.5%; }
.iw-quote .iw-col3 { width: 11.5%; }
.iw-quote .iw-col4 { width: 17%; }
.iw-quote .iw-col5 { width: 16%; }
.iw-quote .iw-col6 { width: 10.8%; }

.iw-quote .iw-sum .iw-th--sum { padding: 7px 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.iw-quote .iw-sum .iw-th--sum small { font-size: 11px; }
.iw-quote .iw-td--sum { background: var(--head-fill); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
.iw-quote .iw-head .iw-th { padding: 5px 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.iw-quote .iw-item { height: 30px; }
.iw-quote .iw-item .iw-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.iw-quote .iw-project {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 2;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--thin);
  background: #ffffff;
}
.iw-quote .iw-project span { display: block; }
.iw-quote .iw-blank td { height: 46px; }
.iw-quote .iw-th--plain { background: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; }
.iw-quote .iw-final .iw-th--plain,
.iw-quote .iw-final .iw-td { background: var(--final-fill); }

.iw-quote .iw-th--note { padding: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 4px; }
.iw-quote .iw-note__body {
  padding: 7px 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  text-align: left;
  border: 1px solid var(--thin);
  background: #ffffff;
}
.iw-quote .iw-note__body span { display: block; }

/* --------------------------------- 좁은 화면에서 양식을 통째로 줄여 맞추기 */
/* 위젯이 놓인 칸의 너비를 재서 JS가 아래 클래스 하나를 골라 붙인다.       */

.iw-fit95 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.95; }
.iw-fit90 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.90; }
.iw-fit85 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.85; }
.iw-fit80 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.80; }
.iw-fit75 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.75; }
.iw-fit70 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.70; }
.iw-fit65 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.65; }
.iw-fit60 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.60; }
.iw-fit55 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.55; }
.iw-fit50 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.50; }
.iw-fit45 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.45; }
.iw-fit40 .iw-sheet { zoom: 0.40; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 모바일 */
/* 화면 크기가 아니라 위젯이 놓인 칸의 너비로 판단한다(아임웹 모바일 편집   */
/* 화면은 칸만 좁아지고 화면 자체는 넓기 때문에 미디어쿼리로는 안 잡힌다). */

.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-gate { padding: 22px 16px; border-radius: 12px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-gate__title { font-size: 18px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-gate__desc { font-size: 13px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-gate__row { display: block; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-gate__row .iw-input { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-btn { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; }

.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-form {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding: 14px 12px;
  border-radius: 12px;
}
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-row { display: block; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-row .iw-field { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-label { font-size: 13px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-input { min-height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-check { padding: 4px 0; font-size: 13px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-check input { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-guide { font-size: 12px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-guide--pc { display: none; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-guide--mo { display: block; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-link { font-size: 13px; }

.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-viewtabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-cards { display: block; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile[data-view="summary"] .iw-sheetwrap { display: none; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile[data-view="sheet"] .iw-cards { display: none; }
.iw-quote.is-mobile[data-view="sheet"] .iw-swipe { display: block; }

/* JS가 멈춘 경우를 대비한 최소 안전장치 — 가로로 밀어서 볼 수 있게 한다 */

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .iw-quote .iw-sheetwrap { -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- 인쇄 */
/* 어느 보기 모드였든 인쇄·PDF는 언제나 A4 양식 그대로 나간다.            */

@media print {
  .iw-quote .iw-gate,
  .iw-quote .iw-form,
  .iw-quote .iw-swipe,
  .iw-quote .iw-viewtabs,
  .iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-viewtabs,
  .iw-quote.is-mobile[data-view="sheet"] .iw-swipe { display: none; }
  .iw-quote .iw-cards,
  .iw-quote.is-mobile .iw-cards,
  .iw-quote.is-mobile[data-view="sheet"] .iw-cards { display: none; }
  .iw-quote .iw-sheetwrap,
  .iw-quote.is-mobile[data-view="summary"] .iw-sheetwrap { display: block; overflow: visible; }
  .iw-quote .iw-sheet {
    width: 190mm;
    max-width: none;
    padding: 0;
    zoom: 1;
  }
  .iw-quote .iw-th,
  .iw-quote .iw-td { font-size: 10.5pt; }
  .iw-quote .iw-item { height: 9mm; }
  .iw-quote .iw-blank td { height: 14mm; }
}
</style>

<section class="iw-quote" data-state="locked" data-view="summary" data-quote-root
  data-pin="8282"
  data-form-url=""
  data-roof-base="20000"
  data-roof-wash="15000"
  data-roof-crack="10000"
  data-roof-coat1="15000"
  data-roof-coat2="30000"
  data-roof-coat3="20000"
  data-roof-waste="200000"
  data-roof-clean="200000"
  data-wall-crack="25000"
  data-wall-coat="30000"
  data-wall-sky="700000"
  data-wall-clean="200000"
  data-wall-etc="200000">

  <div class="iw-gate" data-gate>
    <h2 class="iw-gate__title">견적서 만들기</h2>
    <p class="iw-gate__desc">직원용입니다. 접속 번호를 넣어 주세요.</p>
    <div class="iw-gate__row">
      <input class="iw-input" type="password" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" aria-label="접속 번호" data-pin-input>
      <button class="iw-btn" type="button" data-pin-submit>들어가기</button>
    </div>
    <p class="iw-gate__error" data-pin-error hidden>번호가 맞지 않습니다.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="iw-panel" data-panel hidden>
    <section class="iw-form" role="form" aria-label="견적 입력">
      <div class="iw-field">
        <label class="iw-label" for="iw-work">작업항목</label>
        <select class="iw-input" id="iw-work" data-work>
          <option value="roof">옥상방수 (청명옥상방수)</option>
          <option value="wall">외벽방수 (청명종합설비)</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="iw-field">
        <label class="iw-label" for="iw-customer">고객명 · 현장명</label>
        <input class="iw-input" id="iw-customer" type="text" placeholder="예) 카카오프렌즈 지곡점" data-customer>
      </div>
      <div class="iw-row">
        <div class="iw-field">
          <label class="iw-label" for="iw-area">평수</label>
          <input class="iw-input" id="iw-area" type="text" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="51" data-area>
          <span class="iw-hint" data-area-hint></span>
        </div>
        <div class="iw-field">
          <label class="iw-label" for="iw-final">최종 금액 (원)</label>
          <input class="iw-input" id="iw-final" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="비우면 합계 그대로" data-final>
        </div>
      </div>
      <label class="iw-check">
        <input type="checkbox" data-match>
        <span>최종 금액에 맞춰 단가 조정 (방수코트 비율 유지)</span>
      </label>
      <div class="iw-field">
        <label class="iw-label" for="iw-date">견적일</label>
        <input class="iw-input" id="iw-date" type="date" data-date>
      </div>
      <p class="iw-warn" data-warn hidden></p>
      <p class="iw-guide iw-guide--pc">
        아래 견적서가 바로 채워집니다. PDF로 받으시려면 키보드
        <b>Command + P</b> (윈도우는 <b>Ctrl + P</b>) 를 누르고 <b>PDF로 저장</b>을 고르세요.
      </p>
      <p class="iw-guide iw-guide--mo">
        아래에 견적서가 바로 채워집니다. 휴대폰에서 PDF로 남기려면
        아이폰은 <b>공유 → 프린트</b>, 안드로이드 크롬은 <b>오른쪽 위 메뉴 → 공유 → 인쇄</b>에서
        <b>PDF로 저장</b>을 고르세요.
      </p>
      <a class="iw-link" href="/" data-form-link hidden>사진까지 올리고 노션에 등록하려면 → 웹 폼 열기</a>
    </section>

    <div class="iw-viewtabs" role="group" aria-label="보기 방식">
      <button class="iw-tab" type="button" aria-pressed="true" data-view-summary>요약 보기</button>
      <button class="iw-tab" type="button" aria-pressed="false" data-view-sheet>견적서 양식</button>
    </div>

    <div class="iw-cards" data-cards>
      <div class="iw-card iw-card--sum">
        <span class="iw-card__label">합 계 금 액 (부가세별도)</span>
        <b class="iw-card__won" data-card-won>-</b>
        <span class="iw-card__hangul" data-card-hangul></span>
      </div>
      <ul class="iw-list" data-card-rows></ul>
      <div class="iw-card">
        <span class="iw-card__label">공사 · 공급자</span>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>고객</span><b data-card-customer></b></div>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>견적일</span><b data-card-date></b></div>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>공사명</span><b data-card-project></b></div>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>상호</span><b data-card-company></b></div>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>등록번호</span><b data-card-biz></b></div>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>대표자</span><b>윤병동</b></div>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>담당</span><b data-card-owner></b></div>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>연락처</span><b data-card-phone></b></div>
        <div class="iw-kv"><span>결제방법</span><b>착수금 50% · 잔금 50%</b></div>
      </div>
      <div class="iw-card">
        <span class="iw-card__label">특 이 사 항</span>
        <div class="iw-cardnote" data-card-notes></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p class="iw-swipe">종이 양식 그대로입니다. 글씨가 작으면 <b>요약 보기</b>로 확인하세요.</p>

    <div class="iw-sheetwrap" data-sheet-wrap>
      <div class="iw-sheet" data-sheet>
        <h1 class="iw-sheet__title">견 적 서</h1>
        <div class="iw-sheet__rule"></div>

        <table class="iw-top">
          <tbody>
            <tr>
              <td class="iw-greet" rowspan="5">
                <span class="iw-greet__line" data-sheet-date></span>
                <span class="iw-greet__line" data-sheet-customer></span>
                <span class="iw-greet__line">아래와 같이 견적합니다.</span>
              </td>
              <td class="iw-vlabel" rowspan="5"><span>공</span><span>급</span><span>자</span></td>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">등록번호</th>
              <td class="iw-td" colspan="3" data-sheet-biz></td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">상 호 명</th>
              <td class="iw-td" data-sheet-company></td>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">대 표 자</th>
              <td class="iw-td iw-td--seal">
                <span>윤병동</span>
                <img class="iw-seal" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="대표자 도장">
              </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">주 소</th>
              <td class="iw-td iw-td--addr" colspan="3" data-sheet-addr></td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">업 태</th>
              <td class="iw-td">건설업</td>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">종 목</th>
              <td class="iw-td" data-sheet-category></td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">전화번호</th>
              <td class="iw-td">010-5117-8877</td>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">팩 스</th>
              <td class="iw-td">0504-068-5074</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <table class="iw-main">
          <colgroup>
            <col class="iw-col1"><col class="iw-col2"><col class="iw-col3">
            <col class="iw-col4"><col class="iw-col5"><col class="iw-col6">
          </colgroup>
          <tbody>
            <tr class="iw-sum">
              <th class="iw-th iw-th--sum" scope="row">합 계 금 액<br><small>(부가세별도)</small></th>
              <td class="iw-td iw-td--sum" colspan="5" data-sheet-hangul></td>
            </tr>
            <tr class="iw-head">
              <th class="iw-th" scope="col">공사명</th>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="col">품목</th>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="col">수량</th>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="col">단가</th>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="col">금액</th>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="col">비고</th>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
          <tbody data-sheet-rows></tbody>
          <tbody>
            <tr class="iw-total">
              <th class="iw-th iw-th--plain" scope="row">합계</th>
              <td class="iw-td" colspan="3"></td>
              <td class="iw-td iw-td--num" data-sheet-subtotal></td>
              <td class="iw-td"></td>
            </tr>
            <tr class="iw-final">
              <th class="iw-th iw-th--plain" scope="row">최종 네고 금액</th>
              <td class="iw-td" colspan="3"></td>
              <td class="iw-td iw-td--num" data-sheet-final></td>
              <td class="iw-td"></td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <table class="iw-note">
          <tbody>
            <tr><th class="iw-th iw-th--note" scope="col">특 이 사 항</th></tr>
            <tr><td class="iw-note__body" data-sheet-notes></td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <table class="iw-foot">
          <tbody>
            <tr>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">담당</th>
              <td class="iw-td" data-sheet-owner></td>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">연 락 처</th>
              <td class="iw-td" data-sheet-phone></td>
              <th class="iw-th" scope="row">결제방법</th>
              <td class="iw-td">착수금50%,잔금50%</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
{
/* 견적서 생성기 — 평수를 넣으면 회사 양식대로 견적서를 채운다.
   금액 계산은 파이썬 생성기(quote.py)와 같은 규칙을 쓴다.
   화면 폭이 아니라 위젯이 놓인 칸의 너비를 재서 모바일 배치로 바꾼다. */

const PYEONG_TO_M2 = 3.3058;
const AMOUNT_STEP = 1000; // 조정한 금액은 1,000원 단위
const PRICE_UNIT = 10; // 조정한 단가는 10원 단위
const DIGITS = "영일이삼사오육칠팔구";
const SMALL_UNITS = ["", "십", "백", "천"];
const BIG_UNITS = ["", "만", "억", "조"];

const MOBILE_MAX = 620; // 이보다 좁으면 모바일 배치
const SHEET_PX = 718; // 견적서 폭 190mm를 픽셀로 환산한 값
const FIT_STEPS = [95, 90, 85, 80, 75, 70, 65, 60, 55, 50, 45, 40];

const BRANDS = {
  roof: {
    name: "청명옥상방수",
    biz: "254-11-02805",
    addr: "경기 용인시 기흥구 동백죽전대로 205 B202호 D065",
    category: "방수미장 공사업",
    owner: "송경훈",
    phone: "010-4156-4043",
    project: ["옥상", "바닥 방수"],
    notes: [
      "* 공사명: 옥상 방수 공사",
      "* 공사일자: 협의(1-2일 소요)",
      "* 작업방법: 바탕면 정리 → 고압세척 → 프라이머 → 크랙보수 → 하도 작업 → 중도 작업 → 상도작업 → 검수",
      "* 보증기간: 작업구간에 한하여 2년 보증. (다른 부분에 의한 누수는 제외)",
    ],
    items: [
      { name: "바탕면작업", key: "roof-base", perArea: true },
      { name: "고압세척", key: "roof-wash", perArea: true },
      { name: "크랙보수", key: "roof-crack", perArea: true },
      { name: "하도 방수코트", key: "roof-coat1", perArea: true, balance: true },
      { name: "중도 방수코트", key: "roof-coat2", perArea: true, balance: true },
      { name: "상도 방수코트", key: "roof-coat3", perArea: true, balance: true },
      { name: "폐기물처리", key: "roof-waste", perArea: false },
      { name: "보양•청소", key: "roof-clean", perArea: false },
    ],
  },
  wall: {
    name: "청명종합설비",
    biz: "552-08-01511",
    addr: "권선구 서호동로26번길 19 3층 302-A1호",
    category: "방수미장 공사업",
    owner: "송경훈",
    phone: "010-4156-4043",
    project: ["외벽방수"],
    notes: [
      "* 공사명: 외벽 방수 공사",
      "* 공사일자: 협의(1-2일 소요)",
      "* 작업방법: 바탕면 정리 → 프라이머 → 크랙보수 → 표면방수제 → 구조 보강 작업",
      "* 보증기간: 작업구간에 한하여 2년 보증. (다른 부분에 의한 누수는 제외)",
    ],
    items: [
      { name: "크랙보수", key: "wall-crack", perArea: true, balance: true },
      { name: "표면 방수제 도포", key: "wall-coat", perArea: true, balance: true },
      { name: "스카이 차량", key: "wall-sky", perArea: false },
      { name: "보양•청소", key: "wall-clean", perArea: false },
      { name: "잡자재비용", key: "wall-etc", perArea: false },
    ],
  },
};

const root = document.querySelector("[data-quote-root]");

const pick = (name) => root.querySelector(`[data-${name}]`);
const gate = pick("gate");
const panel = pick("panel");
const pinInput = pick("pin-input");
const pinError = pick("pin-error");
const workSelect = pick("work");
const customerInput = pick("customer");
const areaInput = pick("area");
const finalInput = pick("final");
const matchInput = pick("match");
const dateInput = pick("date");
const areaHint = pick("area-hint");
const warnBox = pick("warn");
const formLink = pick("form-link");
const sheetWrap = pick("sheet-wrap");
const summaryTab = pick("view-summary");
const sheetTab = pick("view-sheet");

const toNumber = (text) => {
  const cleaned = String(text || "").replace(/[^\d.]/g, "");
  const value = parseFloat(cleaned);
  return isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
};

const price = (key) => toNumber(root.getAttribute(`data-${key}`));

const won = (value) => Math.round(value).toLocaleString("ko-KR");

/** 1200000 → '일백이십만' (견적서 표기 방식) */
const koreanAmount = (value) => {
  let left = Math.round(value);
  if (left === 0) return "영";
  const groups = [];
  while (left > 0) {
    groups.push(left % 10000);
    left = Math.floor(left / 10000);
  }
  let text = "";
  for (let index = groups.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const group = groups[index];
    if (group === 0) continue;
    let chunk = "";
    for (let pos = 3; pos >= 0; pos -= 1) {
      const digit = Math.floor(group / Math.pow(10, pos)) % 10;
      if (digit > 0) chunk += DIGITS[digit] + SMALL_UNITS[pos];
    }
    text += chunk + BIG_UNITS[index];
  }
  return text;
};

/** 평수와 단가로 견적 줄을 만든다 */
const buildRows = (brand, area) => {
  const rows = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < brand.items.length; i += 1) {
    const spec = brand.items[i];
    const quantity = spec.perArea ? area : 1;
    const unit = price(spec.key);
    if (quantity <= 0 || unit <= 0) continue;
    rows.push({
      name: spec.name,
      balance: spec.balance === true,
      quantity: quantity,
      unit: unit,
      amount: Math.round(quantity * unit),
    });
  }
  return rows;
};

/** 최종 금액에 맞춰 조정 대상의 단가를 원래 비율대로 다시 나눈다 */
const matchToTotal = (rows, target) => {
  const picked = [];
  let fixed = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
    if (rows[i].balance) picked.push(rows[i]);
    else fixed += rows[i].amount;
  }
  if (picked.length === 0) return "조정할 품목이 없습니다.";

  const room = target - fixed;
  if (room <= 0) {
    return `최종 금액이 조정하지 않는 항목 합계(${won(fixed)}원)보다 작습니다.`;
  }

  let weightSum = 0;
  let biggest = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < picked.length; i += 1) {
    weightSum += picked[i].unit;
    if (picked[i].unit > picked[biggest].unit) biggest = i;
  }
  if (weightSum <= 0) return "조정할 품목의 단가가 0입니다.";

  let others = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < picked.length; i += 1) {
    if (i === biggest) continue;
    const share = (room * picked[i].unit) / weightSum;
    picked[i].amount = Math.round(share / AMOUNT_STEP) * AMOUNT_STEP;
    others += picked[i].amount;
  }
  // 반올림 잔액은 비중이 가장 큰 품목(중도)이 흡수해 합계를 정확히 맞춘다
  picked[biggest].amount = room - others;

  for (let i = 0; i < picked.length; i += 1) {
    const perUnit = picked[i].amount / picked[i].quantity;
    picked[i].unit = Math.round(perUnit / PRICE_UNIT) * PRICE_UNIT;
  }
  return "";
};

const quantityText = (value) =>
  Number.isInteger(value) ? String(value) : String(Math.round(value * 100) / 100);

const cell = (text, className) => {
  const td = document.createElement("td");
  td.className = className;
  td.textContent = text;
  return td;
};

const renderRows = (rows, projectLines) => {
  const body = pick("sheet-rows");
  body.innerHTML = "";
  if (rows.length === 0) return;

  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
    const row = rows[i];
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.className = "iw-item";
    if (i === 0) {
      const project = document.createElement("td");
      project.className = "iw-project";
      project.setAttribute("rowspan", String(rows.length));
      for (let line = 0; line < projectLines.length; line += 1) {
        const span = document.createElement("span");
        span.textContent = projectLines[line];
        project.appendChild(span);
      }
      tr.appendChild(project);
    }
    tr.appendChild(cell(row.name, "iw-td iw-name"));
    tr.appendChild(cell(quantityText(row.quantity), "iw-td"));
    tr.appendChild(cell(won(row.unit), "iw-td iw-td--num"));
    tr.appendChild(cell(won(row.amount), "iw-td iw-td--num"));
    tr.appendChild(cell("", "iw-td"));
    body.appendChild(tr);
  }

  const blank = document.createElement("tr");
  blank.className = "iw-blank";
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) blank.appendChild(cell("", "iw-td"));
  body.appendChild(blank);
};

const renderNotes = (lines) => {
  const boxes = [pick("sheet-notes"), pick("card-notes")];
  for (let box = 0; box < boxes.length; box += 1) {
    boxes[box].innerHTML = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
      const span = document.createElement("span");
      span.textContent = lines[i];
      boxes[box].appendChild(span);
    }
  }
};

/** 요약 카드 한 줄 (품목 이름 · 수량×단가 · 금액) */
const listItem = (name, calc, amount, extra) => {
  const li = document.createElement("li");
  li.className = extra ? `iw-listitem ${extra}` : "iw-listitem";
  const title = document.createElement("span");
  title.className = "iw-listitem__name";
  title.textContent = name;
  const detail = document.createElement("span");
  detail.className = "iw-listitem__calc";
  detail.textContent = calc;
  const money = document.createElement("b");
  money.className = "iw-listitem__amount";
  money.textContent = `${won(amount)}원`;
  li.appendChild(title);
  li.appendChild(detail);
  li.appendChild(money);
  return li;
};

/** 휴대폰에서 표 대신 읽는 요약 화면 */
const renderCards = (rows, brand, subtotal, billed, area) => {
  const list = pick("card-rows");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
    const row = rows[i];
    const calc = `${quantityText(row.quantity)} × ${won(row.unit)}원`;
    list.appendChild(listItem(row.name, calc, row.amount, ""));
  }
  if (rows.length > 0) {
    list.appendChild(listItem("합계", "부가세 별도", subtotal, "iw-listitem--total"));
    if (billed !== subtotal) {
      list.appendChild(listItem("최종 네고 금액", "부가세 별도", billed, "iw-listitem--final"));
    }
  }

  pick("card-won").textContent = area > 0 ? `${won(billed)}원` : "-";
  pick("card-hangul").textContent = area > 0 ? `일금 ${koreanAmount(billed)}원정` : "";
  pick("card-customer").textContent = customerInput.value.trim();
  pick("card-date").textContent = dateText(dateInput.value);
  pick("card-project").textContent = brand.project.join(" ");
  pick("card-company").textContent = brand.name;
  pick("card-biz").textContent = brand.biz;
  pick("card-owner").textContent = brand.owner;
  pick("card-phone").textContent = brand.phone;
};

const dateText = (value) => {
  const parts = String(value || "").split("-");
  if (parts.length !== 3) return "";
  return `${parts[0]} 년 ${Number(parts[1])} 월 ${Number(parts[2])}일`;
};

const render = () => {
  const brand = BRANDS[workSelect.value] || BRANDS.roof;
  const area = toNumber(areaInput.value);
  const asked = toNumber(finalInput.value);

  areaHint.textContent = area > 0 ? `≈ ${(area * PYEONG_TO_M2).toFixed(1)}㎡` : "";

  const rows = buildRows(brand, area);
  let warning = "";
  if (matchInput.checked && asked > 0 && area > 0) {
    warning = matchToTotal(rows, asked);
  }
  warnBox.textContent = warning;
  warnBox.hidden = warning === "";

  let subtotal = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) subtotal += rows[i].amount;
  const billed = asked > 0 ? asked : subtotal;

  pick("sheet-date").textContent = dateText(dateInput.value);
  const customer = customerInput.value.trim();
  pick("sheet-customer").textContent = customer ? `${customer} 귀중` : "";
  pick("sheet-biz").textContent = brand.biz;
  pick("sheet-company").textContent = brand.name;
  pick("sheet-addr").textContent = brand.addr;
  pick("sheet-category").textContent = brand.category;
  pick("sheet-owner").textContent = brand.owner;
  pick("sheet-phone").textContent = brand.phone;
  pick("sheet-hangul").textContent =
    area > 0 ? `일금 ${koreanAmount(billed)}원정 ₩${won(billed)}` : "";
  pick("sheet-subtotal").textContent = area > 0 ? won(subtotal) : "";
  pick("sheet-final").textContent = area > 0 ? won(billed) : "";

  renderRows(rows, brand.project);
  renderNotes(brand.notes);
  renderCards(rows, brand, subtotal, billed, area);
};

/** 양식이 칸 안에 들어오도록 축소 비율 클래스를 하나 골라 붙인다 */
const setFit = (width) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < FIT_STEPS.length; i += 1) {
    sheetWrap.classList.remove(`iw-fit${FIT_STEPS[i]}`);
  }
  if (width <= 0 || width >= SHEET_PX) return;
  const percent = Math.floor(((width - 2) / SHEET_PX) * 20) * 5;
  const step = Math.max(40, Math.min(95, percent));
  sheetWrap.classList.add(`iw-fit${step}`);
};

/** 위젯이 놓인 칸의 너비로 모바일 여부를 정한다 */
const applyWidth = () => {
  const width = root.offsetWidth || window.innerWidth || 0;
  if (width <= 0) return;
  if (width < MOBILE_MAX) root.classList.add("is-mobile");
  else root.classList.remove("is-mobile");
  setFit(width);
};

const setView = (mode) => {
  root.setAttribute("data-view", mode);
  summaryTab.setAttribute("aria-pressed", mode === "summary" ? "true" : "false");
  sheetTab.setAttribute("aria-pressed", mode === "sheet" ? "true" : "false");
  applyWidth();
};

const openPanel = () => {
  root.setAttribute("data-state", "open");
  panel.hidden = false;
  gate.hidden = true;
  render();
  applyWidth();
};

const checkPin = () => {
  const wanted = String(root.getAttribute("data-pin") || "").trim();
  const typed = String(pinInput.value || "").trim();
  if (wanted === "" || typed === wanted) {
    pinError.hidden = true;
    openPanel();
    return;
  }
  pinError.hidden = false;
};

const today = () => {
  const now = new Date();
  const month = `0${now.getMonth() + 1}`.slice(-2);
  const day = `0${now.getDate()}`.slice(-2);
  return `${now.getFullYear()}-${month}-${day}`;
};

const setup = () => {
  if (!root) return;

  dateInput.value = today();

  const formUrl = String(root.getAttribute("data-form-url") || "").trim();
  if (formUrl.indexOf("http") === 0) {
    formLink.setAttribute("href", formUrl);
    formLink.hidden = false;
  }

  pick("pin-submit").addEventListener("click", checkPin);
  pinInput.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (event.key === "Enter") checkPin();
  });

  summaryTab.addEventListener("click", () => setView("summary"));
  sheetTab.addEventListener("click", () => setView("sheet"));

  const watched = [workSelect, customerInput, areaInput, finalInput, matchInput, dateInput];
  for (let i = 0; i < watched.length; i += 1) {
    watched[i].addEventListener("input", render);
    watched[i].addEventListener("change", render);
  }

  applyWidth();
  if (typeof ResizeObserver === "function") {
    const watcher = new ResizeObserver(() => applyWidth());
    watcher.observe(root);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", applyWidth);

  if (String(root.getAttribute("data-pin") || "").trim() === "") openPanel();
};

setup();
}
</script>
